(4) View from a moving walkway inside a bright, modern airport terminal with shops and passengers in the background. (5) Handheld shot following a person in a black jacket walking through a sterile white airport jet bridge; a hand reaches out into the frame. (10) Another view from a plane window showing the wing against a blue sky with white clouds. (11) Nighttime street view in an urban area with neon signs, glowing advertisements, and people walking on the sidewalk. (12) View through a window looking down at a city street at night with cars and a crosswalk.
